risk_summary: The excerpt discloses significant liquidity and operating risks, including recurring losses, $20.3 million of operating cash use, only $10.2 million of cash, reduced demand after an FDA safety communication, and substantial doubt about going concern. Management cites secured financing, a planned sale-leaseback, tax refunds, and cost reductions as mitigating actions, but their effectiveness remains uncertain.
